notes: Summary: Mid-market product analytics SaaS. Building in-product conversational assistant + embeddings search for power users. Interested in staged approach: start on Hosted API to prove UX, then move to Dedicated for predictable throughput and lower unit cost.

Business drivers: improve trial->paid conversion for power users, reduce time-to-insight inside product, add reranking for recommendations; cost sensitivity — wants clear unit economics before committing to Dedicated.

Latency / throughput targets: chat p95 <= 250ms for short contexts (8-16 tokens incremental), embeddings throughput ~80-120 reqs/s for batch pipelines, rerank latency target <= 150ms for top-10 queries.
Model preferences: open-models preferred (cost + control). Interested in Redwood catalog suggestions for 7B/13B variants; fallback routing to smaller quantized model for non-critical paths.
Security: SOC2 required, SSO/SAML mandatory, want audit logs for token-level tracing. KMS support required for key isolation. Asking about EU data residency options for customers in EMEA.

POC scope (3 weeks): hosted_api integration for search + chat; ingest 500k doc vectors, evaluate quality and latency, perform cost simulation for 30/90/365 day runs. SE-led integration (Leo) with product eng.
Demos & meetings timeline:
- 2026-01-22: initial hosted API demo (Maya + Leo). Positive feedback on API ergonomics.
- 2026-02-05: security sync — sent security FAQ and SOC2 artifacts (drive link). Asked for KMS/HSM specifics.
- 2026-02-12: POC kickoff (ff_20260212_call_84b1). Set success metrics: latency, top-5 rerank NDCG delta, monthly unit cost target.
- 2026-02-28: mid-POC status call — identified cost hotspots on embeddings pipeline; Redwood Optimize workshop scheduled.
Cost optimization workshop notes (workshop led by Redwood SE + Optimize team):
- Observations: heavy small-batch embedding requests and repeated document prefixes in chat causing KV cache misses. Baseline cost projection for current usage ~ $180k/yr (hosted).

- Recommendations provided: enable prefix KV caching for chat sessions (expected 20-30% token reduction), increase aggregation/mini-batching for embeddings to 256 items per batch during off-peak (expected 30-40% throughput improvement), apply 4-bit quantization profile (Q4/DQ) for 13B rerank model in Dedicated to reduce GPU memory and cost with minimal quality loss.
- Unit economics: presented scenarios showing Dedicated at commit level ~35% lower unit cost if average utilization >= 55%. Showed break-even month/commit sizing table (drive link to pricing deck).
- Quick wins: cache TTL tuning + batching for nightly bulk embedding jobs; immediate ~$6k/month projected savings if applied.
Technical blockers surfaced in workshop:
- Current ingestion pipeline uses synchronous single-item embedding calls (needs batching refactor).
- Network egress policy for VPC will affect Dedicated setup; Eng needs architecture diagram for firewall rules.

Quotes and customer sentiment: 'Need predictable latency at scale — we can’t have tail spikes during demos', 'If Dedicated gets us under $0.02 per 1k tokens equivalent for embeddings we'll consider commit', product lead emphasized cost visibility for finance team.

Pricing / commercial conversations: discussed Dedicated sizing options (reserved GPU pools) and monthly commit levels. Finance asked for a 12-mo commit vs. 3-mo ramp scenario. Redwood to provide detailed TCO model by 2026-03-17.
